thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Director Arthur D. Levinson Sells 1,521 Shares

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Director Arthur D. Levinson Sells 1,521 Shares
text:
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Director Arthur D. Levinson sold 1,521 shares of Apple that occurred on Friday, February 1st. The shares were sold $167.71, for a total value of $255,086.91. Following the completion of the sale, the director now directly owns 1,134,804 shares in the company, valued at approximately $190,317,978.84. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is accessible through this hyperlink .
Shares of NASDAQ AAPL traded up $2.93 during midday trading on Tuesday, hitting $174.18. 36,062,367 shares of the company’s stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 33,686,140. The company has a current ratio of 1.30, a quick ratio of 1.25 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.79. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $142.00 and a 12 month high of $233.47. The company has a market capitalization of $818.47 billion, a P/E ratio of 14.62, a P/E/G ratio of 1.71 and a beta of 1.13.
